probe_detail.name: Sets up an expectation and then turns it
A specific concrete detail carries the joke
Trailing furniture: hashtags, handles, parenthetical byline
Extent of capitalised or shouted typography

final.name: Implies an off-screen scene with a before and after
final.audit_justification: Judges the joke's use of implied off-screen narrative, a comic-structure craft technique intrinsic to the entry's content.

final.name: Orthographic irregularity
final.audit_justification: Measures surface spelling/grammar irregularity, an orthographic habit rather than joke content, though a careful writer's editing discipline could also track genuinely better craft.
final.upstream_parent: submission haste, mobile entry, or external editing

final.name: Raw length of the content span excluding tags
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a length ruler that disclaims any judgment of appropriateness, though brevity discipline from a practised writer could also correlate with tighter, better-crafted entries.
final.upstream_parent: editing effort and revision before posting, plus how much of the character budget the author felt obliged to fill

final.name: Hashtag-specific reframing
final.audit_justification: Directly evaluates how well the entry's premise fits and reinterprets the specific prompt, a core comic-craft judgment.

final.name: Stops on the beat: no explanation, parenthetical, or hedging second joke
final.audit_justification: Evaluates comic restraint and timing (stopping at the punchline versus undercutting it), a craft judgment about delivery.

final.name: Prompt-language echo
final.audit_justification: Measures mere presence of prompt-wording reuse without judging its use, a boilerplate-phrasing marker whose likely cause (uncreative reliance on the prompt) would not itself produce better writing.

final.name: Contest-wrapper arrangement
final.audit_justification: Purely a formatting/ordering measure of the required handle and hashtag, a venue-boilerplate marker unconnected to joke quality.

final.name: Emphasis typography
final.audit_justification: Measures amount of emphatic typography without judging its effect, a typographic habit rather than a joke-quality signal.

final.name: Information density
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether wording is economical and load-bearing versus padded, a craft judgment about writing quality.

final.name: Well-formed utterance versus bare noun-pile filling the word count
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the entry is an actual constructed utterance versus an unconnected keyword list, bearing on whether genuine linguistic/comic construction is present rather than merely surface style.

final.name: Taboo-content density
final.audit_justification: Measures sheer amount of taboo vocabulary while explicitly disclaiming any judgment of whether it is funny or effective, a subject-matter marker rather than a craft signal.

final.name: Reference-stacking clutter
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether references serve or clutter a single coherent premise, a genuine craft judgment about coherence.

final.name: Graphic/visceral taboo imagery
final.audit_justification: Gated on taboo subject matter, so it is partly a topic marker, though the sensory specificity it rewards is a genuine descriptive-craft skill that could also produce better writing elsewhere.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction is gated on subject matter: an entry cannot score above 0 unless it is about a taboo/transgressive topic, so a high score is first evidence that the entrant picked a gross-out target rather than evidence about how well the joke works. The sensory-specificity requirement layered on top is a real descriptive-craft skill that plausibly produces better writing independent of topic, so it is mixed.

final.name: Idiomatic repurposing
final.audit_justification: Evaluates creative redirection of an idiom toward the premise, a craft/originality judgment.

final.name: Concrete visuality
final.audit_justification: Assesses vividness of the scene the wording creates, a craft judgment about descriptive quality.

final.name: Political-figure/current-event audacity
final.audit_justification: Detects choice of a specific hot-button political topic rather than craft quality, though entrants willing to commit to a bold, unhedged topical stance may also tend to write more fully-committed, better entries.
final.arbiter_reason: Scoring turns on naming a currently contested political figure or event, which is a topic-and-temporal marker: the same craft applied to a non-political prompt scores 0, so a high score reports what the entry is about and when it was written, not how good it is. The secondary requirement of a blunt, unhedged stance may co-occur with fully committed writing, so it is mixed.

final.name: Depth beyond title substitution
final.audit_justification: Evaluates how substantially a borrowed structure is transformed rather than superficially swapped, a craft/originality judgment.

final.name: Franchise-fatigue / sequel-exhaustion meta-joke
final.audit_justification: Detects a specific thematic topic bucket (jokes about franchise fatigue) rather than judging execution quality within it.
final.arbiter_reason: This is a pure thematic bucket detector: it asks only whether the content is about sequels/franchise over-extension and contains no clause that evaluates execution, timing, or surprise within that theme, so a well-made and a hackneyed sequel joke score identically at 10. Because nothing in the instruction rewards quality, its upstream cause is topic selection alone and I see no plausible genuine-quality component to preserve.

final.name: Boilerplate tag placed before vs. after the punchline
final.audit_justification: Purely measures ordering of required boilerplate relative to the punchline, an explicit non-quality formatting marker.
final.upstream_parent: curation/provenance pipeline (which scrape or compiled list the item was drawn from) and/or author's routine practice of appending vs. prepending required tags

final.name: Stereotype-list dependence
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether identity markers are lazily accumulated versus each doing distinct comic work, a craft/originality judgment.

final.name: Non-authored mechanical residue: whitespace runs, entities, shortened URLs
final.audit_justification: Measures transport/encoding residue explicitly disclaimed as unrelated to authorial care.
final.upstream_parent: the client used to compose plus the scrape/encoding pipeline that captured the tweet (hashtag autocomplete inserting spaces; attachments and quote-links; entity escaping at ingestion)

final.name: Trailing or leading single-word ALL-CAPS emphasis
final.audit_justification: Measures presence of a single all-caps emphasis word without judging its effectiveness, a typographic habit.

final.name: Expectation reversal
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether the ending meaningfully overturns the setup, a core comic-structure craft judgment.

final.name: Named-reference density
final.audit_justification: Measures raw density of named references without judging their use, a subject-matter marker, though a culturally fluent writer capable of weaving in many references may also write richer, better-crafted call-backs.

final.name: Shock independence
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether humor survives removal of the taboo/shock element, directly judging whether genuine comic craft underlies the entry.
